name: Debug code in specialized programming languages
description: Users asked for assistance in debugging, fixing, or correcting syntax, logical, and runtime errors in code written in a wide variety of specialized languages and frameworks, such as Delphi, ActionScript, Rust, 1C:Enterprise, and CMake. These requests often involved specific functional contexts like game development, data processing, or configuration management, requiring targeted solutions beyond generic debugging.
